description: Use this to find citable PadelTrue documents for a named padel racket. Supply concise brand/model/year/shape keywords, for example counter veron or bullpadel hack 05 2027. It is literal keyword retrieval, not natural-language buyer matching: every keyword must match. For budget or playing-style shortlists use search_rackets. Returns document IDs, titles and canonical product URLs; use fetch to read the evidence. Empty results describe this catalogue query, not the entire market.

query.description: Brand, model, exact year or shape keywords. Exclude conversational filler and budget/style constraints. Example: nox at10 18k 2026.

name: search
title: Search padel rackets by name
